name: CSF1-receptor signaling driving osteoclast formation
rationale: Members combine M-CSF/CSF1R (and related interleukin) signaling with macrophage proliferation/fusion and osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption; the osteoclast/bone arm separates it from monocyte/dendritic-differentiation confusables, and the CSF1 arm from DAP12/syncytium confusables.

name: Platelet activation via soluble-agonist receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation, and the theme uniquely carries ADP (P2Y1/P2Y12), thrombin (PAR), thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling, whereas confusables emphasise collagen/GP1b adhesion or integrin-Rap1 signaling.

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and Wnt/PCP signaling plus convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation and organogenesis and neural plate morphogenesis; convergent extension distinguishes it from axial/paraxial mesoderm and non-canonical Wnt internalization confusables.

core: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by G-protein-coupled receptors
name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: Members concern Gi/Gz-mediated inhibition of adenylate cyclase and cyclic-nucleotide GPCR signaling, exemplified by alpha-2 adrenoceptors; this separates it from PKA-activation, muscarinic/adenosine Gi and insulin-secretion adrenergic confusables.

name: NK-cell cytotoxicity regulation by surface receptors
rationale: Members regulate NK (and T) cell cytotoxicity, degranulation, activation and cytokine output via NK surface/activating receptors and MHC class Ib recognition, distinct from confusables built on KIR clusters, granzyme killing or CD8 T-cell proliferation.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of face, palate, nose, neuro- and viscerocranium and fore/hindlimbs and digits with mesenchymal development, whereas confusables add pharyngeal-derived organs (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid) or ossification.

name: Integrin-fibronectin focal adhesion signaling
rationale: Members cover integrin production, fibronectin matrix formation, focal adhesion assembly, SRF-linked cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration; focal adhesion and fibronectin assembly separate it from syndecan/stress-fiber and EMT confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle growth restraint and disuse atrophy
rationale: Members negatively regulate myoblast/myotube differentiation and muscle development, maintain satellite cells, and cover atrophy, inactivity responses and SCF-proteasome catabolism, contrasting with confusables on contraction, hypertrophy or pro-myogenic differentiation.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance by recombination and replication, D-loop/t-circle handling, telomere capping and BIR with recombination-intermediate resolution; BIR and DNA unwinding distinguish it from confusables focused on C-strand synthesis, R-loops or general DSB repair.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members cover GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis, forskolin response, PKA activation and a cAMP-controlled exocytosis effect; PKA activation separates it from adenylate-cyclase-inhibition and CREB-phosphorylation confusables.

name: COPI-coated vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members are COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, distinguishing it from COPII export, SRP/ER-insertion and tethering confusables.

name: Kidney development through nephron tubule formation
rationale: All members concern kidney development (intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, metanephros), and the theme uniquely carries nephron segment and tubule formation (renal vesicle, comma/S-shaped bodies, loop of Henle, distal tubule), whereas confusables centre on ureteric bud formation.

core: Membrane traffic to the plasma membrane
name: Plasma membrane delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members concern endosomal organization, endocytosis and recycling of receptors and proteins back to the plasma membrane plus Golgi-to-surface and cholesterol transport, distinct from retrograde endosome-to-Golgi and constitutive-secretion confusables.

name: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor fate
rationale: Members cover transcriptional programs (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis) in myeloid progenitors, their proliferation and the restraint of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise committed granulocyte or monocyte differentiation.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK kinase cascade in oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF and MAP2K/MAPK activation, oncogenic RAS/BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K mutants and ERK dephosphorylation feedback; the RAF-level and mutant signaling distinguish it from confusables centred on RAS GAPs or SOS/RIT upstream regulation.

name: Vitamin K and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members concern vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of proteins and ascorbate metabolism and transport, with vitamin E response, separating it from oxygen-transport, vitamin E/ubiquinol and vitamin D confusables.

name: CCL5 and dendritic-cell cytokine production via STING
rationale: Members regulate CCL5 and dendritic-cell cytokine and chemokine production together with cGAS-STING activation and cGAMP import, distinguishing it from interferon-negative, Th1-polarizing, TLR7/8/9 and CXCL/macrophage-chemotaxis confusables.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and small RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation/modification with snRNP and snoRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and snRNA/scaRNA trafficking, which separates it from pseudouridylation, diphthamide and RNA-folding confusables.

name: mRNA stability and translation control in stress granules
rationale: Members regulate mRNA stabilization/destabilization, translation and localization via RNA-binding proteins together with stress-granule assembly, PKR and arsenite stress, distinct from confusables centred on TTP/BRF1/KSRP-driven decay and decapping.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation in developing cartilage and joints
rationale: Members regulate chondroblast/chondrocyte differentiation, proliferation, hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and morphogenesis and embryonic joint morphogenesis; joint morphogenesis and condensation distinguish it from ossification, tendon and articular-homeostasis confusables.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion control by nutrient sensing
rationale: Members concern pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion and processing regulated by glucose, fatty acids, incretins, K-ATP channels and neurotransmitters, distinct from confusables on insulin action, IRS/AKT signaling and GLUT4 translocation.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome system with linkage-specific deubiquitination
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin activation, linkage-specific chain assembly and DUB families, proteasome assembly and proteasomal degradation, which separates it from autophagy/ERAD quality-control and neddylation/COP9 confusables.

name: Golgi architecture and COPI-mediated vesicle traffic
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon assembly/disassembly, intra-Golgi and Golgi-ER COPI traffic and Rab/ARF GTPase control, distinct from TGN-to-endosome/lysosome and COPII export confusables.

name: Proline-centred amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are generic alpha-amino acid metabolism terms plus glutamine-family metabolism and proline biosynthesis and catabolism; proline distinguishes it from serine/glycine/glyoxylate and organic-acid confusables.

name: Vitamin A metabolism toward retinoic acid
rationale: Members concern retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism, retinoid transport and its diseases; retinoic acid synthesis separates it from the visual-cycle confusable, and metabolism rather than retinoid response from the others.

name: Telomere end protection against inappropriate recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging, NHEJ protection, inhibition of telomeric recombination and restraint of telomerase, contrasting with confusables on t-circle/D-loop processing, C-strand synthesis or telomerase extension.

name: Energy and redox nucleotide cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport, NAD/NADP salvage and phosphocreatine metabolism, unlike confusables on PRPP synthesis, adenine transport or apoptosis regulation.

name: Telomere maintenance with Cajal-body telomerase recruitment
rationale: Members span telomerase extension and holoenzyme assembly, C-strand synthesis, recombination-based maintenance, capping and senescence, and the theme alone carries telomerase RNA trafficking to Cajal bodies, separating it from broad DNA-repair and chromatin confusables.

core: Inflammatory cytokine control by bacterial sensing
name: Inflammatory cytokine control via TLR2/4 and NLRP3 inflammasome
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4 lipopeptide/LPS detection, NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine production, distinct from caspase-4/5/AIM2 pyroptosis, TRIF/NF-kB and monocyte-identity confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt-beta-catenin signaling governed by AXIN stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF target activation and destruction-complex integrity, notably AXIN degradation and stabilization and APC/AXIN1 mutants, distinguishing it from DVL, FZD/LRP and target-repression confusables.
